-- Phase 1: specification for reading public notes.
-- Names are untrusted; only files under the `notes` directory may be read.

-- True when `path` stays inside `notes` after normalizing `.` and `..`.
-- Absolute paths and any path that climbs above `notes` are rejected.
inside_notes(path: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or path.char_count() > 0
  ex inside_notes("a.txt") == True
  ex inside_notes("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex inside_notes("..") == False
  ex inside_notes("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex inside_notes("sub/../../x") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts[0] == "" and parts.len() > 1
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for seg in parts
    if seg == "" or seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Returns the text of `notes/path`, or "" when the path escapes `notes`
-- or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out == "" or inside_notes(path)
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("no-such-file-for-spec.txt") == ""
  if inside_notes(path) == False
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(path) else ""
  text
